title: Linking sales commission data between financial systems and CRM
outcome: Manual link between financial systems and CRM fully automated
challenge: Commission data moved between the financial systems and the CRM through a manual process — slow, error-prone, and dependent on a handful of people who knew the steps.
whatWeDid: We built an automated integration for commission data between the financial systems and the CRM, with validation on every transfer.
results: Validated data flow between finance and CRM
